content: Capturing selected text system-wide requires simulating Ctrl+C/Cmd+C via enigo crate then reading clipboard via arboard. This has race conditions: clipboard must be saved/restored, timing delays needed between key simulation and clipboard read, and registering Ctrl+C as a global shortcut breaks native copy functionality (Tauri issue #12038). macOS needs Accessibility permissions for keyboard simulation. Some apps may not respond to simulated keystrokes.
